title: Playing games to heal kids
author: emulsifier
body:
Hey guys, some of you may have heard about the ExtraLife charity. Basically its a 24 hour videogame marathon taking place on Oct. 16th. I am raising money for Primary Children’s Medical Center in Salt Lake City, if you have a few extra bucks to spare, head on over to this site and send a few bucks their way, it’s for a good cause.

There are other ways you can help too! If you don’t have the cash, or want to otherwise get involved the entire event is open to anyone who wants to participate. Sign up and create your own team here (you can even choose the hospital of your choice for the funds to be donated to when you sign up)

For any other information, you can take a gander at the offical ExtraLife charity site here
